pairs.target: xiūxirì de yuànzi lǐ dā qǐ le ǎi tái , tǎ wéi jīngguò shí , chàdiǎn bèi yìgēn shéng bànzhù .
pairs.english: A low stage stood in the courtyard on the rest day. Passing it, Tavi nearly tripped over a rope.
pairs.hanzi: 休息日的院子里搭起了矮台，塔维经过时，差点被一根绳绊住。

pairs.target: yīwén cóng táihòu shēnshǒu fú le tā yíxià , yòu lìkè bǎshǒu suōhuíqù , hùzhù huáilǐ yìdié gāng xiě hǎo de gē yè .
pairs.english: Iven reached from behind the stage to steady him, then quickly withdrew his hand to protect a stack of freshly written song sheets.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文从台后伸手扶了他一下，又立刻把手缩回去，护住怀里一叠刚写好的歌页。

pairs.target: mò hái méi gān , tā de xiàbā shàng yǐjīng cèng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The ink was still wet, and some had already smeared onto his chin.
pairs.hanzi: 墨还没干，他的下巴上已经蹭了一点。

pairs.target: jīntiān gōng fāng ràng láikè kàn xuéshēng zuò de dōngxī , fànhòu háiyǒu jǐshǒugē .
pairs.english: Today the workshop welcomed visitors to see student work, with a few songs after the meal.
pairs.hanzi: 今天工坊让来客看学生做的东西，饭后还有几首歌。

pairs.target: tóng jiē chéng lái yànkàn fēng láng xiūshàn de rén yě zài , qiánpái bǎi le kàobèiyǐ , xuéshēng dàduō zìjǐ bān dèngzǐ .
pairs.english: Copperstep's wind-gallery repair inspectors were there too. Backed chairs stood in front; most students brought their own stools.
pairs.hanzi: 铜阶城来验看风廊修缮的人也在，前排摆了靠背椅，学生大多自己搬凳子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū le tāmen zuò guò de shuāng líng jià , bèi fàngzài lìng yìzhāng zhuōshàng , méiyǒu rén pèng , pángbiān yā zhe jìlùzhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized their paired-bell apparatus on another table, untouched, with its record sheet weighted beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出了他们做过的双铃架，被放在另一张桌上，没有人碰，旁边压着记录纸。

pairs.target: mǐlā hé sū yǐ cóng wūjià nàbiān guòlái , dàilái yìzhāng zhédié de xiǎo tú .
pairs.english: Mira and Suyi arrived from the roof-framing area with a folded drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和苏苡从屋架那边过来，带来一张折叠的小图。

pairs.target: tāmen xiān qù jiāo tú , ràng tǎ wéi zài táihòu děng yíhuìer . yīwén què méiyǒu xiàng píngshí nàyàng chènjī shuō gè xiàohuà , zhī dīng zhe zuì shàngmiàn nà zhāng gē yè .
pairs.english: They went to hand it in, asking Tavi to wait backstage. Iven offered no usual joke, staring at the top song sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 她们先去交图，让塔维在台后等一会儿。伊文却没有像平时那样趁机说个笑话，只盯着最上面那张歌页。

pairs.target: " shǎo le yíduàn . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “A verse is missing,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “少了一段。”他说。

pairs.target: dài gē de gāoniánjí xuéshēng zhèngzài xì xiù dài , wénshēng táitóu .
pairs.english: The senior student leading the singers looked up from tying his sleeve band.
pairs.hanzi: 带歌的高年级学生正在系袖带，闻声抬头。

pairs.target: " shàngwǔ jiù shuō guò le . qiánmiàn kàn qìjù yòng de shíjiān cháng , zánmen zhī chàng liǎngduàn . "
pairs.english: “We said so this morning. The apparatus viewing takes longer; we only get two verses.”
pairs.hanzi: “上午就说过了。前面看器具用的时间长，咱们只唱两段。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào zhī chàng liǎngduàn . kě wèishénme huànchéng zhè yíduàn ? "
pairs.english: “I know it's two verses. But why switch to this one?”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道只唱两段。可为什么换成这一段？”

pairs.target: yīwén zhǐzhe zhǐ shàng xīn chāo de cí . tǎ wéi còu guòqù , zhī rènchū tóng jiē , chángqiáo jǐgè zì , xuánlǜ dǎo shì tīng tāmen liàn guò de .
pairs.english: Iven pointed at the freshly copied words. Tavi leaned closer, recognizing only Copperstep and long bridge, though he had heard them practice the tune.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文指着纸上新抄的词。塔维凑过去，只认出铜阶、长桥几个字，旋律倒是听他们练过的。

pairs.target: " lái de rén shú zhè bǎn , dàjiā yě dōu huì . bái jiǎ nàduàn hái dé chóngxīn duì wěiyīn . "
pairs.english: “The guests know this version, and so does everyone here. The Whitecape verse needs its ending worked out again.”
pairs.hanzi: “来的人熟这版，大家也都会。白岬那段还得重新对尾音。”

pairs.target: " wǒmen zuótiān yǐjīng duì guò le . "
pairs.english: “We worked it out yesterday.”
pairs.hanzi: “我们昨天已经对过了。”

pairs.target: gāoniánjí xuéshēng bǎ xiù dài chě jǐn , liǎnshàng yě yǒu le diǎn fánzào .
pairs.english: The older student pulled his band tight, irritation showing on his face.
pairs.hanzi: 高年级学生把袖带扯紧，脸上也有了点烦躁。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ xiǎng zěnmebàn ? děnghuìer shàngtái zài shāngliáng ? "
pairs.english: “Then what do you want? Discuss it onstage in a moment?”
pairs.hanzi: “那你想怎么办？等会儿上台再商量？”

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu jiē . tā yòng zhǐjiǎ mǒdiào gē yè biān de yìxiǎo tuán mò , mò fǎndǎo tuō chéng le yídào huī hén .
pairs.english: Iven didn't answer. He scraped a blot of ink from the page edge with his nail, only spreading it into a gray streak.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有接。他用指甲抹掉歌页边的一小团墨，墨反倒拖成了一道灰痕。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā bǎ nà zhāng zhǐ fàngdào le zuì xiàmiàn , dòngzuò hěn màn .
pairs.english: Tavi watched him place that sheet underneath the rest, very slowly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见他把那张纸放到了最下面，动作很慢。

pairs.target: rén lùxù jìn yuàn , táiqián de dèngzǐ bèi nuó dé luàn xiǎng .
pairs.english: People entered the courtyard, stools clattering before the stage.
pairs.hanzi: 人陆续进院，台前的凳子被挪得乱响。

pairs.target: dài gē de rén qù zhǎo hái méi lái de liǎnggè rén , yīwén zhàn zài zhù biān , zuǐchún dòngledòng , méiyǒu chū shēng .
pairs.english: The leader went to find two missing singers. By a post, Iven moved his lips without a sound.
pairs.hanzi: 带歌的人去找还没来的两个人，伊文站在柱边，嘴唇动了动，没有出声。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn , shǎo de nàduàn shì shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi asked what the missing verse was.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问，少的那段是什么。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ jiù gē yè nágěi tā kàn , shàngmiàn xiě zhe bái jiǎ kāizhá sòng shuǐ , xiàmiàn cái shì qiáo hé yuǎn lái de chē .
pairs.english: Iven showed him an old sheet: Whitecape opening gates to send water, followed by bridges and arriving carts.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把旧歌页拿给他看，上面写着白岬开闸送水，下面才是桥和远来的车。

pairs.target: zhǐ jiǎo zhé guò hěn duōcì , xiàng tā yǐjīng zài shǒulǐ niē le hǎo jǐtiān .
pairs.english: The corners were folded many times, as though he had held it for days.
pairs.hanzi: 纸角折过很多次，像他已经在手里捏了好几天。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎoshíhòu tīng de jiùshì zhège . chàng wán shuǐ cái chàng qiáo . "
pairs.english: “This is what I heard growing up. Water first, then the bridge.”
pairs.hanzi: “我小时候听的就是这个。唱完水才唱桥。”

pairs.target: " nà xiànzài zhège , yě shì zhè shǒugē ? "
pairs.english: “And this version now is the same song?”
pairs.hanzi: “那现在这个，也是这首歌？”

pairs.target: " shì . lù yì cháng , cí jiù duō . dào le shuí jiāménkǒu , jiù duō chàng shuíjiā liǎngjù . "
pairs.english: “Yes. The longer the road, the more verses. At each doorstep, they sing a few more lines about that household.”
pairs.hanzi: “是。路一长，词就多。到了谁家门口，就多唱谁家两句。”

pairs.target: tā xiàng zài jiǎng xiàohuà , què méi xiào .
pairs.english: He sounded as though he were joking, but didn't smile.
pairs.hanzi: 他像在讲笑话，却没笑。

pairs.target: mǐlā huílái , tīngjiàn zuìhòu yíjù , shuō tā cóngxiǎo tīng de běnlái jiùshì tóng jiē nàduàn . tā fùqīn gēn rén xiūqiáo shí , yě chàng guò .
pairs.english: Mira returned in time for the last line and said she'd grown up with Copperstep's verse. Her father had sung it repairing bridges with his crew.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉回来，听见最后一句，说她从小听的本来就是铜阶那段。她父亲跟人修桥时，也唱过。

pairs.target: " wǒ méi shuō nǐmen bùnéng chàng . " yīwén shuō .
pairs.english: “I didn't say you couldn't sing it,” Iven said.
pairs.hanzi: “我没说你们不能唱。”伊文说。

pairs.target: " nǐ gāngcái nàyàng shuō , hǎoxiàng zhǐshì bǎ míngzì tiānshàngqù . " " wǒ shuō de búshì nǐ fùqīn . "
pairs.english: “You made it sound as if we just stuck a name in.” “I wasn't talking about your father.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你刚才那样说，好像只是把名字添上去。”
“我说的不是你父亲。”

pairs.target: sū yǐ bǎ xiǎo tú jiá zài gēbo xià , cháo táiqián kàn le yìyǎn , shuō tā xiān qù zhàn dèngzǐ .
pairs.english: Suyi tucked the drawing under her arm, glanced toward the stage and said she'd save stools.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡把小图夹在胳膊下，朝台前看了一眼，说她先去占凳子。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu gēnzhe zǒu . tǎ wéi zhàn zài liǎng rén zhōngjiān , juéde zìjǐ kāikǒu tì shuí jiěshì dōu huì gèngzāo .
pairs.english: Mira stayed. Between them, Tavi felt any attempt to explain either side would worsen things.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有跟着走。塔维站在两人中间，觉得自己开口替谁解释都会更糟。

pairs.target: tā zhī wèn yīwén , wěiyīn jiūjìng nǎlǐ bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: He only asked Iven how the endings differed.
pairs.hanzi: 他只问伊文，尾音究竟哪里不一样。

pairs.target: yīwén dīshēng chàng le bànjù , tíng zài zuìhòu yígè zì shàng .
pairs.english: Iven sang half a line softly, pausing at the final word.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文低声唱了半句，停在最后一个字上。

pairs.target: mǐlā shú de nà bǎn shōu dé duǎn , bái jiǎ zhè yíjù yào duō zhuǎn yíxià , xiàng shuǐ ràoguò shítou cái luòxiàqù .
pairs.english: Mira's familiar version ended short. Whitecape's phrase turned once more, like water rounding a stone before falling.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉熟的那版收得短，白岬这一句要多转一下，像水绕过石头才落下去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnzhe shì , zhuǎn dào yíbàn , qì xiān méi le .
pairs.english: Tavi tried along with him, running out of breath halfway through the turn.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟着试，转到一半，气先没了。

pairs.target: yīwén zhōngyú kàn le tā yìyǎn . " nǐ búyòng gēnzhe biē . " " wǒ méi biē , shì méiyǒu le . "
pairs.english: Iven finally looked at him. “No need to hold your breath.” “I didn't hold it. There wasn't any left.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文终于看了他一眼。
“你不用跟着憋。”
“我没憋，是没有了。”

pairs.target: mǐlā xiào le yíxià , yòu bǎ xiào shōuzhù . táiqián kāishǐ jiào rén , yīwén bǎ gē yèlǐ qí , zǒu chūqù , zhàn dào hòupái yuánlái nàge wèizhì .
pairs.english: Mira smiled, then checked herself. They were calling for singers, and Iven straightened his pages and took his usual place in the back row.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉笑了一下，又把笑收住。台前开始叫人，伊文把歌页理齐，走出去，站到后排原来那个位置。

pairs.target: tǎ wéihé mǐlā zuòzài sū yǐ liú de dèngzǐ shàng . gē qǐ shí , qiánpái yǒu gèrén gēnzhe diǎntóu , pángbiān de háizi tīngbùdǒng cí , zhī dīng zhe yīwén xiàbā shàng de mò .
pairs.english: Tavi and Mira sat with Suyi. As the song began, someone in front nodded along, while a child who didn't understand the words stared at the ink on Iven's chin.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维和米拉坐在苏苡留的凳子上。歌起时，前排有个人跟着点头，旁边的孩子听不懂词，只盯着伊文下巴上的墨。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái xiǎng shìyì tā cādiào , táiqǐ shǒu yòu fàngxià .
pairs.english: Tavi meant to signal him to wipe it away, but raised his hand and lowered it again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来想示意他擦掉，抬起手又放下。

pairs.target: yīwén chàng le yìn zài zhǐ shàng de liǎngduàn , méiyǒu línshí huàn cí .
pairs.english: Iven sang the two printed verses, making no last-minute change.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文唱了印在纸上的两段，没有临时换词。

pairs.target: tā zhècì quèshí chàng dào le zuìhòu , shēngyīn yě méiyǒu suōjìn biérén hòumiàn .
pairs.english: He really did reach the end this time, his voice not shrinking behind the others.
pairs.hanzi: 他这次确实唱到了最后，声音也没有缩进别人后面。

pairs.target: zhǎng shēngxiǎng qǐlái shí , mǐlā pāi dé hěn yònglì , tǎ wéi yě gēnzhe pāi , kě tā ěrduo lǐ hái liú zhe nà jù méiyǒu chàng wán de chángyīn .
pairs.english: When applause rose, Mira clapped hard and Tavi joined in, but the unfinished long note still lingered in his ears.
pairs.hanzi: 掌声响起来时，米拉拍得很用力，塔维也跟着拍，可他耳朵里还留着那句没有唱完的长音。

pairs.target: sànchǎng yǐhòu , tāmen bāngmáng bān dèngzǐ . yīwén bào zhe liǎngzhāng wǎng qiángbiān zǒu , téng bù chūshǒu cā xiàbā ,
pairs.english: Afterward they helped carry stools. Iven took two toward the wall, unable to wipe his chin.
pairs.hanzi: 散场以后，他们帮忙搬凳子。伊文抱着两张往墙边走，腾不出手擦下巴，

pairs.target: mǐlā biàn bǎ yíkuài shībù dā zài zuì shàngmiàn , ràng tā fàng hǎo dèngzǐ zài yòng .
pairs.english: Mira laid a wet cloth on the top stool for him to use after putting them down.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉便把一块湿布搭在最上面，让他放好凳子再用。

pairs.target: " wǒ búshì juéde nǐ nàduàn bùgāi chàng . " tā shuō . " wǒ zhīdào . " " nǐ gāngcái bù zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “I wasn't saying your verse shouldn't be sung,” she said. “I know.” “You didn't before.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我不是觉得你那段不该唱。”她说。
“我知道。”
“你刚才不知道。”

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ dèng jiǎo duìqí , guò le yíhuìer cái shuō : " gāngcái wǒ shuí dehuà dōu búdàxiǎng tīng . "
pairs.english: Iven aligned the stool legs before finally saying, “I didn't much want to hear anyone just then.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把凳脚对齐，过了一会儿才说：“刚才我谁的话都不大想听。”

pairs.target: mǐlā méi tì nà zhāng gē yè biànjiě . tā wèn , xiàhuí pái de shíhòu , néng bunéng bǎ liǎngduàn dōu liú zhe .
pairs.english: Mira didn't defend the song sheet. She asked if both verses could stay next rehearsal.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没替那张歌页辩解。她问，下回排的时候，能不能把两段都留着。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō dé wèn dài gē de rén , bùnéng yóu tā yígè rén dìng , búguò kěyǐ wèn .
pairs.english: Iven said they'd need to ask the leader; it wasn't his decision alone, but they could ask.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说得问带歌的人，不能由他一个人定，不过可以问。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng táihòu jiǎnqǐ bèi fēngchuī luò de jiù gē yè , dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Tavi picked up the old sheet blown behind the stage and handed it to him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从台后捡起被风吹落的旧歌页，递给他。

pairs.target: yīwén yào zhéqǐlái , tǎ wéi què ànzhù yìjiǎo . " hòumiàn háiyǒu shénme ? "
pairs.english: Iven began to fold it, but Tavi held a corner. “What's after that?”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文要折起来，塔维却按住一角。
“后面还有什么？”

pairs.target: " nǐ búshì shuō méi qì le ? " " xiànzài yǒu le . "
pairs.english: “Weren't you out of breath?” “I have got some now.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你不是说没气了？”
“现在有了。”

pairs.target: tāmen zuò dào qiánggēn shèngxià de nàtiáo chángdèng shàng . yīwén bǎ zhǐ tān zài xītóu , zhècì cóngtóu chàng gěi tā tīng .
pairs.english: They sat on the remaining bench by the wall. Iven spread the paper on his knees and sang it for him from the beginning.
pairs.hanzi: 他们坐到墙根剩下的那条长凳上。伊文把纸摊在膝头，这次从头唱给他听。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu qiǎng zhe jiē zìjǐ shú de cí , zhī zài chángyīn jiéshù shí qīngqīng dǎ le yíxià pāizi .
pairs.english: Mira didn't rush in with her familiar words, only marking the beat gently when the long note ended.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有抢着接自己熟的词，只在长音结束时轻轻打了一下拍子。

pairs.target: yuǎnchù yǒurén bǎ kàobèiyǐ bānhuí wūlǐ , yǐ tuǐ zài ménkǎn shàng kē le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Farther away, someone carried the backed chairs inside, knocking a leg against the threshold.
pairs.hanzi: 远处有人把靠背椅搬回屋里，椅腿在门槛上磕了一声。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chàng cuò le yígè zì , yīwén tíngxiàlái gǎi , yòu cóng nà yíjù chóng lái .
pairs.english: Tavi sang one word wrong. Iven stopped to correct him and started that line again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维唱错了一个字，伊文停下来改，又从那一句重来。
